article_title: How to Crop a PDF File Online
article_paragraph_01: Scanned documents, exported reports, and downloaded PDFs often contain excessive margins, headers, footers, or empty space you don't need. The Crop PDF tool lets you visually trim any page to keep only the content that matters — without converting to images or losing quality.
article_paragraph_02: Upload your PDF file and use the interactive crop handles to define the area you want to keep. You can also type exact margin values in millimeters, points, or inches for pixel-perfect precision. Apply the same crop to all pages at once or adjust each page individually.
article_paragraph_03: All processing is done directly in your browser — files are never uploaded to a server. The cropped PDF preserves all original text, links, and annotations. No registration is required and the tool is completely free to use.
